title: Verify joined CCP2 production-vector consumption
description:
Scope: joined consumer evidence for the frozen corpus in /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/test/vectors/ and its conformance mapping in /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/docs/ccp-conformance.md. Compare independent manifest expectations with actual Python, Rust and C consumer results and source/corpus revisions. Verify missing, duplicate, unknown and empty consumption failures. This completion gate belongs under joined CI, not independent corpus .6; it does not change frozen expectations or require RF qualification.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Use the existing manifest/result format and a focused aggregation check. Depend only on vectors.11 and the three concrete consumer leaves; joined CI later combines this evidence with production integration and admission gates.
acceptance_criteria: All three actual production-API consumers ran against the same reviewed corpus revision, with exact equality between expected and consumed applicable case-ID sets. Negative loader/dispatch checks fail as specified, and no result is produced by duplicating production logic in the consumer. Record real commands, artifacts and review evidence. Policy/wire evidence is distinguished from scheduler/driver integration, software-constraint supplements and RF/authorization evidence. Corpus freezing remains complete independently of this gate.
